name: Gem Digger
description: A marble-shooter mode on an auto-scrolling board. Shoot colored marbles to pop matching groups down to the conveyor, and free the gems buried in the field.
howToPlay: Aim with your finger and tap to shoot. Forming a group of 3+ same-color marbles releases them — and anything left hanging below drops too. Wrong-color shots stick and fill the board. Free the gems by clearing whatever holds them up from below. Survive as long as you can and collect as many gems as possible — the run ends only if the board reaches the red danger line or the conveyor overflows.
